fixed_question: Does learning the same professional reasons and actions with their correct project/state/object pairing improve complete rooms compared with separated learning?

source_data_roles.core: Real-project sourced reasons plus explicitly mapped objects and genuinely executed reconstructed actions.
source_data_roles.scene_datasets: HSSD/3D-FRONT supply geometry/assets and baseline scenes; never silently substitute for original project reasons or identity.
source_data_roles.synthetic: Researcher/model-generated scenarios, reasons or counterfactuals remain labelled auxiliary controls, not professional evidence.

eligibility_principles: Use source-supported parts with attribution; missing historical CAD/tool logs does not prohibit a labelled reconstruction.
Keep original designer statement, later scholarly analysis, researcher inference and independent reviewer judgment separate.
Objective geometry/use labels may come from validated measurements. Aesthetic/comfort/professional preference labels need appropriate independent review.
Assess complete-room side effects even when one supervised action is partial. Do not silently drop unsupported functions.

Keep source project evidence separate from researcher-constructed transfer tasks. Cross-project application is allowed if labelled and its conditions validated; it is not a historical professional action.
Both main arms receive identical admitted reasons and actions; source differences cannot confound pairing.
Current development-exposed families cannot become sealed test. Training remains separately authorized.
priority_rule: Next work must close a named gap in a sourced decision, the paired/separate comparison, or whole-room evaluation. Broad downloads/imports are justified only by a concrete dependency; no independent full-corpus cleanup project.
next_deliverable: Use the completed source-guided candidates to specify a fixed-model baseline with identical source knowledge and finite action budgets across contrasting activity conditions. Stop repeated manual placement/loader audits on the completed STORAGE and Waterloo examples. Independent source families, full usability and training approval remain separate gaps.

data_layers.professional_knowledge: Attributed conditions, principles and tradeoffs; no 3D action or extra reviewer required to establish what a designer said.
data_layers.professional_evaluation: Actual professional critiques, scores, rankings or edits; no full trajectory required. Never simulate a professional identity.
data_layers.scene_action: Licensed geometry and actual tool execution; missing professional reasons means action-only or objective diagnosis, not invented rationale.
data_layers.professional_decision_pair: Correctly mapped professional evidence, reconstructed task, objects, executed actions and consequences. Positive, mixed, negative and unknown outcomes remain distinct.

main_and_diagnostic_controls.main: Truthful identical reasons and actions, separated versus paired; compare against frozen model with same knowledge retrieval and sufficient prompting.
main_and_diagnostic_controls.auxiliary: Train-time shuffled pairing and inference-time replaced rationale are separate diagnostic interventions; neither is necessary or sufficient proof of professional learning.
main_and_diagnostic_controls.confounds: Mismatched reasons can introduce contradictory supervision; length matching alone does not equalize information, computation or difficulty.
